def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    candidates = []
    for color, count in counts.items():
        if count != 2:
            continue
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = sorted(pts)
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:
            candidates.append((max(r1, r2), color, r1, c1, r2, c2))
    if candidates:
        _, color, r1, c1, r2, c2 = max(candidates)
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        r, c = r2+dr, c2+dc
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
            g[r][c] = color
            r += dr
            c += dc
    return g
"
}
